gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words in solid, readable blocks. Megrim, meanwhile, is all angular, futuristic edges with every stroke cut to one measured thickness, while the body quietly handles the actual reading.
gen-megrim-gf-numans: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with every stroke ending at one measured thickness, while Numans spaces its swollen lowercase wide. Sharp lines against loose spacing is the whole appeal.
gen-megrim-gf-onest: Onest reads approachable and contemporary, with short ascenders sitting above big, generous bowls. And a long block of it would feel easygoing, with Megrim keeping things angular and futuristic above.
gen-megrim-gf-oxygen: Futuristic and angular, Megrim draws every stroke at one thickness. Oxygen follows with open curves and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so extended reading feels smooth and unhurried.
gen-megrim-gf-parkinsans: Futuristic and angular up top, Megrim hands off to Parkinsans, whose wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk. Sharp display attitude meets small-size clarity, and neither one gives any ground.
gen-megrim-gf-savate: Megrim brings angular, futuristic strokes, every one cut to a single measured thickness. Savate gently softens it with sturdy hairlines and a tall, rounded o, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sofia-sa: Love Ya Like A Sister is expressive and bold, with outward-pointing terminal tips. Sofia Sans sits beside it with tall, modern lowercase and no thick-and-thin modulation at all, giving the headings room to be loud.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sono: Warnes spreads bold, expressive strokes that taper out before touching. Let Sono take a modest bump in size; its wide spacing and tall lowercase carry the text with professional ease.
gen-irish-grover-gf-stack-sans-headline: Fun is the mood of Irish Grover, tall and sturdy. Stack Sans Headline brings tidy monoline discipline to the organic fun, and that tension is what makes it work.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-puritan: Puritan reads rounded and approachable, with forms that stay clearly open to the side. Funnel Display supplies the commanding spaghetti-like strokes up top, and the oversized counters below keep it friendly.
